verdicts.reason: Both re-stack the design sensibly for the tall format and keep the brand intact, but both break the headline so 'fizz' sits alone on its own line, and both crop the circles hard. A sits the product low, which leaves a big gap under the logo. Its CTA is jammed right under the body copy, and the button nearly touches the tan circle in the bottom-left. B moves the whole stack up, so the logo/product/headline spacing is more even and the CTA gets more room above and below. That makes B somewhat more balanced, though the gap between product and headline is still loose.
